entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Did anything change? We went in, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The security guards seem to be gone,[n]but it's difficult to tell for certain...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This seems to be similar to what happened[n]with Sis's Palace.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But this time, the Diet Building remains[n]unchanged...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Ah... The gate wasn't open earlier though.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That means we're definitely in a Palace.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, let's go take a look.
